February 7, 1933. Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS.

China Evening News:

THE WORLD ANTI-IMPERIALIST LEAGUE.

Yang Heng-ver, Vice-President of the Central Research Society of the National Government, made the following statement to our reporter on the morning of February 5:-
"Persons of distinction throughout the world are proposing to organise a body to be known as "The Three Eastern Provinces Present Condition Inquiry Group" which will proceed to the North East to make an investigation. This proposal was made by the World Anti-Imperialist League, a very influential body, organised by well-known men throughout the world. Most of the members of the League are weak and minor races such as Indians, Egyptians, including members of Socialist Parties, Communist Parties, etc. in Great Britain, America, France, Germany and other foreign nations.
"The office of the League is in Europe. Madame Sun Yat-sen is the Honorary President of the League.
"Following the outbreak of the North-Eastern Incidents, the League expressed its opposition and organised a "Hands Off China" movement. The object of the League's Inquiry Group to make investigation in the North East is similar to that of the Lytton Inquiry Commission of the League of Nations; the only difference being that the Lytton Inquiry Commission is an Imperialist body and the League's Inquiry Group is anti-Imperialist. The League suggests holding meetings in China after the completion of the inquiry. We should receive the League's Inquiry Group in a similar manner as we received the Lytton Inquiry Commission. I do not know whether Japan will object to the League's Inquiry Group proceeding to Manchukuo."

Chen Pao and other local newspapers:

SURTAX ON AMUSEMENT RESORTS IN THE SETTLEMENT.

（批：L.HHS7）
The Municipality of Greater Shanghai has received an order from the Executive Yuan instructing that a surtax be imposed on various amusement resorts the proceeds of which are to be used for the relief of the North-Eastern Sufferers.
The Finance Bureau has been instructed to deal with the matter. The enforcement of this surtax was commenced on February 1.
It is learned that the surtax is already being enforced in Chinese controlled territory but the authorities of the International Settlement and the French Concession have not yet enforced it. Negotiations will be opened with the two authorities by the Chief of the Finance Bureau.
（批：S）

《中国晚邮报》：

世界反帝同盟。

国民政府中央研究院副院长杨铨（Yang Heng-ver）于2月5日上午向本报记者发表如下声明：
“世界各地知名人士正提议组织一个名为‘东北现状调查团’的团体，前往东北进行调查。该提议由世界反帝同盟提出，这是一个由全球知名人士组成的极具影响力的团体。该同盟成员多为印度人、埃及人等弱小民族，以及英国、美国、法国、德国和其他外国的社会党、共产党等政党成员。
“该同盟总部设在欧洲。宋庆龄女士为该同盟名誉主席。
“自东北事变爆发以来，该同盟表示反对，并组织了‘不许干涉中国’运动。该同盟调查团赴东北调查的目的，与国际联盟的李顿调查团相似；唯一区别在于，李顿调查团是帝国主义机构，而该同盟调查团则是反帝国主义的。该同盟建议在调查结束后在中国举行会议。我们应以接待李顿调查团的同样方式接待该同盟调查团。我不知道日本是否会反对该同盟调查团进入满洲国。”

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

租界娱乐场所附加税。

（批：L.HHS7）
上海特别市政府收到行政院命令，指示对各类娱乐场所征收附加税，所得款项用于救济东北难民。
已指令财政局处理此事。该附加税已于2月1日开始征收。
据悉，华界已在征收该附加税，但公共租界和法租界当局尚未征收。财政局局长将与这两方当局展开谈判。
（批：S）

June 6, 1932.
Afternoon Translation.

COMMUNISM

Dah Loh Sin Wen (大洛新聞), a mosquito paper, published the following article on June 5:

AGITATION FOR RELEASE OF THE NOULENS COUPLE.

Subsequent to the arrest of the Noulens couple, famous writers and educationalists in various foreign countries sent letters and telegrams to Nanking enquiring into the case and lodging protests with the Nanking Government against the arrest. Some time ago, Madame Sun Yat-sen issued a long circular arguing for the release of the couple.
Recently, Chinese writers and thinkers have issued the following manifesto bearing the signatures of Li Chi Hwa (李濟華), Li Da (李達), Wang Shing Chien (王省三), Wang Hung Fah (王洪發), Eur Kuh Sien (歐古仙), Van Zoong Yuin (范宗潤), Kwang She Yee (廣社義), Huang Mo Yen (黃墨言), Ting Ling (丁玲), Huung Ts Kuo (洪子國), Sung Ts Yuen (宋慈元), Chien Siau Tseu (錢小秋), Doo Hang (杜衡), Moo Sze Ying (穆時英), Zung Faung Dau (曾方道), Dau Ping Sung (陶平松) and Boon Ts (文子):-
"Eminent men throughout the world are endeavouring to effect the release of the Noulens couple who have been detained for a period of ten months in a gloomy Chinese jail. At this advanced stage of civilization, such inhuman and ancient criminal law should not be involved to deal with revolutionists who are working for the emancipation of the people. At the instigations of the British, Japanese and French Imperialists, the Chinese Government may impose the death penalty on the couple. At the present juncture when the Imperialists are conspiring with Japan to partition China, we can distinguish friend from foe. For the purpose of supporting humanity and resisting the Imperialists, the Chinese Government should not impose the death penalty on the Noulens couple and thereby evade the trap laid by the British, Japanese and French Imperialists.
"All Chinese people in the country are hereby urged to rise unanimously to prevent the Government from passing the death penalty on the Noulens couple and to agitate for their immediate release."

Great Crystal (大晶報), a mosquito paper:

THE NOULENS CASE AND AHN CHONG HAO.

It is absolutely necessary that the National Government should charge Noulens, a foreigner without nationality, against whom proofs to do harm to China by spreading Communism have been found. Yet eminent men throughout the world are supporting him and have criticised the Chinese Government. Some Chinese who were dissatisfied with the arrest of Noulens protested against the Government for detaining him. All such people have no regard for the law.
Ahn Chong Hao, who is a Chinese citizen, has been removed by the Japanese authorities to Korea for punishment. Nevertheless, these same eminent men have not said anything in his defence.

共产主义

小报《大洛新闻》于6月5日刊登了以下文章：

呼吁释放牛兰夫妇。

继牛兰夫妇被捕后，各国著名作家和教育家纷纷致信或致电南京，查询案情，并就逮捕一事向南京政府提出抗议。此前不久，宋庆龄女士发布长篇通电，主张释放该夫妇。
近日，中国作家和思想家发布了以下宣言，署名者包括李济华、李达、王省三、王洪发、欧古仙、范宗润、广社义、黄墨言、丁玲、洪子国、宋慈元、钱小秋、杜衡、穆时英、曾方道、陶平松和文子：
“全球知名人士正努力促成被关押在阴暗的中国监狱长达十个月的牛兰夫妇获释。在文明如此进步的今天，不应动用这种不人道的古老刑法来对付致力于人民解放的革命者。在英、日、法帝国主义的唆使下，中国政府可能会对该夫妇判处死刑。在当前帝国主义与日本勾结瓜分中国的关头，我们可以分清敌友。为了支持人道主义并抵抗帝国主义，中国政府不应判处牛兰夫妇死刑，从而避开英、日、法帝国主义设下的陷阱。
“特此呼吁全国同胞一致起来，阻止政府对牛兰夫妇判处死刑，并鼓动立即释放他们。”

小报《大晶报》：

牛兰案与安重根。

对于牛兰这个无国籍外国人，已有证据表明其通过传播共产主义危害中国，国民政府对其提起公诉是绝对必要的。然而，全球知名人士却支持他，并批评中国政府。一些对逮捕牛兰不满的中国人也抗议政府拘留他。所有这些人都无视法律。
中国公民安重根已被日本当局移送至朝鲜受罚。然而，这些同样的知名人士却未为他说过任何辩护的话。
